===== ATTEMPTED SOURCE E: Bank of England IADB (official) - NOT USABLE =====
URL: https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/boeapps/iadb/fromshowcolumns.asp?SeriesCodes=IUDMNZC
DATE,IUDMNZC
21 Sep 2026,5.1935
22 Sep 2026,5.2113
23 Sep 2026,5.3055
Two reasons not used: (1) the series stops at 23 Sep - BoE publishes with a ~2 working-day
lag, so there is no Thu 24 / Fri 25 observation yet; (2) IUDMNZC is a 10-year NOMINAL PAR
yield, a different measure from the benchmark gilt redemption yield the ticker quotes
(5.31 par vs ~5.36 benchmark on 23 Sep), so it is not a like-for-like tiebreak.
FINAL: 5.36, -0.03 stands on MarketWatch (5.355, -0.029) + Trading Economics (5.3593, -0.03)
+ Investing.com (-0.0252), against CNBC's outlier -0.0129.
